compatibility.notes: No project-format or settings migration is introduced by this release. The immutable beta.2 CLI reopened a beta.3-created project and the restored beta.3 backup with matching story, passage, and link summaries. A separate project-folder backup remains recommended before prerelease use.

rollback.application: Uninstall or discontinue using beta.3 and reinstall the previous known-good beta.2 release. Automatic downgrade is unavailable.
rollback.projectData: Beta.2 can reopen the unchanged beta.3 project format. If project-data recovery is required, stop editing, restore the separate pre-beta.3 project-folder backup, and reopen that restored project with beta.2.

knownIssues: In the current benchmark suite, some latency and memory results at the largest tested project sizes exceed the project’s initial performance targets.
Advanced Harlowe syntax editing is specific to the bundled Harlowe 3.3.9 format; other Harlowe versions use the generic editor.
Asset-complete Package export is limited to file-backed desktop projects. Static runtime dependencies are assessed, while dynamic JavaScript dependency discovery is explicitly not evaluated.
Some inherited compatibility user interface and documentation remain outside the primary Twine RS workbench.
Cross-platform packaged-app and hosted-CI performance coverage remains incomplete.
